idea-plugin.name: ARGB Color Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Preview and edit ARGB colors directly in Java code.

ARGB Color Lens displays a gutter swatch for eight-digit Java colors (0xAARRGGBB) and for references to final Java fields initialized with a matching hexadecimal literal.

  • Hover to highlight a swatch's expression; customize or disable its color in Settings.
  • Left-click to change only the selected expression.
  • Right-click to update the original constant definition.
  • Preview alpha transparency on a checkerboard and edit opacity using IntelliJ IDEA's native color picker.

Supports Java source files in IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 and newer. Computed and chained color expressions are not supported yet.

Open source on GitHub. Developer: @aliaga1924.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.4.0 — Highlight settings and clearer tooltips

  • Enable or disable source highlighting in Settings > Tools > ARGB Color Lens.
  • Choose a custom highlight color or match each ARGB swatch automatically.
  • Persist preferences across projects and IDE restarts.
  • Show symbolic reference names but never repeat a literal's hexadecimal value.
  • Retain native color editing and English/Spanish localization.
